scope: T2 PostgreSQL golden: an overlay of the k3s golden, dedicated and disposable; the CloudNativePG operator and every PostgreSQL Cluster run only inside twins booted from it; no shared Incus/Kubernetes/registry/tunnel/deploy state and no real database
recipe: incus exec k1 -- timeout 600 sh -c 'until k3s kubectl get --raw=/readyz >/dev/null 2>&1 && k3s kubectl get node k1 >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done' && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready node/k1 --timeout=600s && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n kube-system rollout status deploy/coredns --timeout=600s && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n kube-system rollout status deploy/local-path-provisioner --timeout=600s
test "$(incus list k1 -c 4 --format csv | grep -o '10\.0\.100\.[0-9]*')" = 10.0.100.113 && incus config device override k1 eth0 ipv4.address=10.0.100.113

incus exec k1 -- k3s ctr images pull ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg@sha256:923c267ec29636db3bee20f993d0ec4973fa22998e1adad37da79e4d32b5bc07 && incus exec k1 -- k3s ctr images tag ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg@sha256:923c267ec29636db3bee20f993d0ec4973fa22998e1adad37da79e4d32b5bc07 ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg:1.30.1

incus exec k1 -- k3s ctr images pull ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql@sha256:f76ba02680a07bdafaa00c81827351b15e671ac11e0e6a0b72f8ee5835cc82c6 && incus exec k1 -- k3s ctr images tag ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql@sha256:f76ba02680a07bdafaa00c81827351b15e671ac11e0e6a0b72f8ee5835cc82c6 ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:16-minimal-trixie

curl -fsSL -o /tmp/cnpg.tgz https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/charts/releases/download/cloudnative-pg-v0.29.1/cloudnative-pg-0.29.1.tgz && echo 'b53d3991fe84bcf38767e7702cae78666265427a127a26fff168ab4207d2b1df  /tmp/cnpg.tgz' | sha256sum -c - && printf '%s' 'monitoring:
  enabled: false
config:
  maxConcurrentReconciles: 1
webhook:
  livenessProbe:
    initialDelaySeconds: 30
  readinessProbe:
    initialDelaySeconds: 30
  startupProbe:
    failureThreshold: 24
    periodSeconds: 5
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 25m
    memory: 32Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 128Mi
' > /tmp/cnpg-values.yaml && helm template cloudnativepg /tmp/cnpg.tgz --namespace cnpg-system --include-crds -f /tmp/cnpg-values.yaml > /tmp/cnpg.yaml && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl create namespace cnpg-system && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl apply --server-side -f - < /tmp/cnpg.yaml && rm -f /tmp/cnpg.tgz /tmp/cnpg-values.yaml /tmp/cnpg.yaml
incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n cnpg-system wait --for=condition=Available deployment --all --timeout=600s
timeout 600 sh -c 'until incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n cnpg-system get endpoints cnpg-webhook-service -o jsonpath={.subsets[0].addresses[0].ip} | grep -q .; do sleep 2; done'

incus exec k1 -- k3s crictl images -q | sort > /tmp/images-before && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl create namespace parity-warm && printf '%s' 'apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: warm
  namespace: parity-warm
spec:
  instances: 1
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:16-minimal-trixie
  storage:
    size: 256Mi
' | incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl apply -f - && timeout 900 sh -c 'until [ "$(incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n parity-warm get cluster warm -o jsonpath={.status.readyInstances})" = 1 ]; do sleep 5; done' && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl delete namespace parity-warm --wait=true --timeout=600s && incus exec k1 -- k3s crictl images -q | sort | diff /tmp/images-before - && rm /tmp/images-before
timeout 600 sh -c 'while incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl get pv -o jsonpath={.items[*].spec.claimRef.namespace} | grep -qw parity-warm; do sleep 2; done'
